thread:
Ellen: Ops asked to enable autoswitch fallback for rollout-v2 tomorrow. Quick trade-off q: sampling rate for audit rows? want actionable but not spammy.
Ravi: My vote: front-loaded sampling then decay. e.g. 20% first 15m -> linear down to 0.5% over 8h. captures startup flakiness.
Sofia: +1. Also we should expose a tiny "fallback pill" on the rollout card with reason + rate: `soft  latency_p95  4%`. Click to expand digest.
Kei: On reasons, please move away from numeric codes. propose enum `latency_p95`, `upstream_5xx`, `quota_hit`, `model_infer_err`.
Ellen: Good. Operator controls: quick snooze (5m/30m/2h) no note; "hold" override requires a short reason and must create an audit row.
Ravi: Implement cooldown for holds: 0m -> 10m -> 1h -> 4h. Show history: `holds:2 (last:Sofia 9m ago)`.
Sofia: UI: show a compact digest that lists top 3 reasons with counts and one sampled trace link, full audit accessible via pagination.
Kei: Telemetry fields to include in decision event: `decision_id`, `rollout_id`, `decision_ts`, `fallback_reason`, `degrade_mode`, `override_action`, `override_actor`, `override_ttl`, `policy_rev`, `prev_route`, `fallback_variant`.
audit-bot: Note: rollout-v2-autoswitch scheduled by @Ellen at 1763501150. Monitoring channels subscribed.
Ellen: Action items: Sofia mock card + digest, Ravi spec sampling decay, Kei publish telemetry schema diff, I'll gate flip until mocks land. No objections?
Ravi: No objections. PR incoming.
Sofia: Figma mock by EOD.
Kei: Schema diff this afternoon.
Ellen: Thanks all :thumbsup:
